name: Cultural Anthropology and Philosophy, BA (Boston)
disclaimer: NU Map is an independent, student-built planner. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data is scraped from Northeastern's public catalog and refreshed on a schedule; always confirm with the official catalog and an academic advisor.

legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. A section can consist of nothing but these. Quote them; never infer from them that a particular course does or does not satisfy the section.
legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.

requirementSections.title: Area Courses
notes: Complete two area courses in the range from ANTH 4101–ANTH 4520 not used to satisfy other requirements. One study-abroad course may be substituted as an area studies course with prior permission from the department. Additional area courses taken may count as anthropology electives.

requirementSections.title: Electives
notes: Complete three 4-semester-hour courses not used to satisfy another requirement in addition to the above requirements. One study-abroad course may also count toward this requirement with prior permission from the department.

requirementSections.title: Advanced Philosophy Electives
notes: Complete two PHIL courses with a designation of 3000 or above not used to satisfy another requirement and at least one at the 4000 or 5000 level, except 5110.

requirementSections.title: Critical Philosophy Elective
notes: Complete one of the following not used to fulfill other requirements:

requirementSections.title: Philosophy Electives
notes: Complete two additional courses from the philosophy department.

requirementSections.title: Integrative Requirement
notes: One integrative course is required from each discipline. Courses taken as electives above may not be used as integrative courses.

gpaRequirements.title: Cultural Anthropology and Philosophy Combined Major Credit Requirement
gpaRequirements.text: Minimum 2.000 GPA required in anthropology and philosophy courses
